name: Localization Coverage
query:
select
	te.locale as "Locale:Link/Locale Profile:90",
	lp.locale_label as "Locale Name::140",
	lp.language as "Language:Link/Language:70",
	lp.currency as "Currency:Link/Currency:60",
	te.app as "App::140",
	te.origin as "Measurement Route::110",
	coalesce(nullif(te.string_class, ''), 'UI Text') as "String Class::100",
	count(*) as "Total:Int:70",
	sum(case when te.translated_text is null or te.translated_text = '' then 0 else 1 end)
		as "On Screen:Int:90",
	round(100 * sum(case when te.translated_text is null or te.translated_text = '' then 0 else 1 end)
		/ count(*), 1) as "Coverage on Screen:Percent:130",
	sum(case when te.translation_source in ('Own','Fallback') then 1 else 0 end)
		as "Own:Int:70",
	round(100 * sum(case when te.translation_source in ('Own','Fallback') then 1 else 0 end)
		/ count(*), 1) as "Own Coverage:Percent:110",
	sum(case when te.translation_source = 'Inherited' then 1 else 0 end)
		as "Inherited from Parent:Int:140",
	sum(case when te.translated_text is null or te.translated_text = '' then 1 else 0 end)
		as "Untranslated:Int:90"
from `tabTranslation Entry` te
inner join `tabLocale Profile` lp on lp.name = te.locale
where te.status != 'Not Applicable'
group by te.locale, lp.locale_label, lp.language, lp.currency, te.app, te.origin,
	coalesce(nullif(te.string_class, ''), 'UI Text')
order by te.locale asc, te.app asc, te.origin asc,
	field(coalesce(nullif(te.string_class, ''), 'UI Text'), 'UI Text', 'Role Name', 'Master Data')
